Emergency Fallback Configuration

This endpoint allows authorised personnel to apply calendar settings when the primary admin interface is unavailable.

POST /fallback/apply

Submits a configuration update using the current session token for authentication.

Request Headers
X-Auth-Token: <session_token> Content-Type: application/json
Request Body
{ "setting": "default_view", "value": "weekly" }
Example Response (200 OK)
{ "confirmation_code": "CAL-UPD-8822" }
This is a pre-approved emergency access method. Usage is logged for audit purposes.
